name: IRC_LI_RSC_SYNC_HISTORY
description: Stores the history of calls that were made as part of LinkedIn RSC integration

columns.name: SYNC_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the ORC Entity. Can be PERSON_ID, REQUISITION_ID, SUBMISSION_ID.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of ORC entity. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_ENTITY_TYPE

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action to be excuted by the sync. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_ACTION

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of this sync action. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_SYNC_STATUS

columns.name: SYNC_ERROR
columns.description: The error, if any, of the sync action.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_LI_RSC_BATCH_HISTORY

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Additional info for the record being synced

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: Queue id. This is from a queue table column

columns.name: PROCESSOR_ID
columns.description: Processor id of queue table column

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Assocated entity id from queue table column

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: Retry count from queue table column

columns.name: PROCESS_AFTER_DATE
columns.description: Process after date from queue table column

columns.name: Q_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Creation date from queue table column

columns.name: Q_CREATED_BY
columns.description: Created by from queue table column

columns.name: Q_LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Last updated by from queue table column

columns.name: Q_LAST_UPDATED_DATE
columns.description: Last updated date from queue table column

columns.name: Q_LAST_UPDATED_LOGIN
columns.description: Last updated login from queue table column

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYLOAD
columns.description: The OAC(Onsite Apply Configuration) data for requisition
